raw_text: We are seeking a Senior Backend Engineer to architect high-throughput transactional payment systems. You will design distributed microservices, optimize PostgreSQL database queries, implement caching layers with Redis, and ensure fault-tolerant idempotency. Requires 4+ years experience with Python, FastAPI/Flask or Go, PostgreSQL, Docker, and AWS.
core_responsibilities: Architect and scale distributed payment transaction microservices handling 10k+ requests/sec.
Design zero-downtime database migrations on PostgreSQL clusters.
Ensure high reliability, idempotency, and sub-50ms API response times.

raw_text: HireMind is looking for a Fullstack Engineer to develop generative AI workflows and modern web dashboards. You will build responsive React/Next.js frontends, write clean Python/Flask backends, integrate LLM APIs (Gemini/OpenAI), and implement vector search with pgvector.
core_responsibilities: Develop interactive web interfaces using modern component architectures.
Build scalable RESTful API endpoints and integrate generative AI agents.
Optimize end-to-end user latency from frontend rendering to database retrieval.

raw_text: Join our AI Platform team to build production-grade Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines and multi-agent systems. You will work with PyTorch, vector databases (pgvector), embedding models, evaluation benchmarks, and MLOps deployment pipelines.
core_responsibilities: Implement dense vector retrieval pipelines and optimize cosine similarity search.
Evaluate LLM output quality, hallucination rates, and inference latency.
Collaborate with backend engineers to deploy robust agentic AI microservices.

raw_text: Looking for a Frontend Engineer passionate about web performance, animations, and clean design systems. Must have deep expertise in React 18, Next.js, TypeScript, responsive CSS, and Core Web Vitals optimization.
core_responsibilities: Build high-performance web components with sub-second page loads.
Implement design system tokens, responsive layouts, and accessible UI.
Monitor and optimize Largest Contentful Paint (LCP) and Cumulative Layout Shift (CLS).
